content: Minimal pyproject.toml for src layout pip install: requires [build-system] with hatchling + requires-python, [project] with name/version/dependencies, and [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] packages = ['src/palimpsest']. Alternative without pyproject.toml [project] section: set ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/src in Dockerfile — simpler for Docker-only deployment. Current palimpsest pyproject.toml only has [tool.ruff], no [project] section. README quickstart shows pip install -e . which currently fails. For Dockerfile: PYTHONPATH approach requires no pyproject.toml changes. For full pip install support: add [project] section with hatchling.
